Definition: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
BiblicalUsage: 1) priest, principal officer or chief ruler; 1a) priest-king (Melchizedek, Messiah); 1b) pagan priests; 1c) priests of Jehovah; 1d) Levitical priests; 1e) Zadokite priests; 1f) Aaronic priests; 1g) the high priest
